rule: Adopt only when a tool replaces a named function in a current loop. Research novelty is not a reason to integrate.

candidates.name: Partial Lenses
candidates.function: Bidirectional optics over JSON; read/write through the same optic, partial isomorphisms, pointer-based lenses.
candidates.fit: High conceptual fit for projection round-trip experiments.
candidates.test: Implement one tiny projection mapping and verify GET–PUT / PUT–GET / rejection. Do not make the kernel depend on it unless it materially reduces adapter code.

candidates.name: Tuval
candidates.function: Local-first pages/databases/issues/infinite canvas over one record set; board ↔ semantic Markdown/JSON agent round-trip.
candidates.fit: Very close to the 'one object, many views, agent handoff' problem.
candidates.test: Study its board semantic graph export and agent round-trip. Borrow mechanism only; do not replace current repo/control topology.

candidates.name: vpype-js
candidates.function: TypeScript/browser/Node SVG transformation pipeline, layout, path optimization, layers, HPGL.
candidates.fit: Excellent for digital → stencil/plot/proof pipeline and keeps vector transforms scriptable.
candidates.test: Run one existing SVG through layout + stat + optimized SVG output; preserve source hash and generate a Return receipt.

candidates.name: Typst
candidates.function: Programmable typesetting with CLI compile/watch and strong PDF output.
candidates.fit: Excellent for data-driven A3 plans, build sheets, labels and printable reference plates.
candidates.test: Generate one A3 proof sheet from canonical JSON without hand-editing layout.

candidates.name: Automerge
candidates.function: Local-first JSON-like CRDT with mergeable change history.
candidates.fit: Potential future sync substrate if the same canonical object genuinely needs multi-device concurrent editing.
candidates.test: None now. Append-only local events are simpler for current proofs.

candidates.name: Project Nodal / GraphLink class
candidates.function: Spatial/local-first graph interfaces for AI conversations and reasoning branches.
candidates.fit: Useful interface donors for conversation archaeology and spatial re-entry.
candidates.test: Extract one navigation/re-entry mechanism; reject wholesale Thinking-OS/dashboard adoption.
